newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos Sept sugar shipments up from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos Sept sugar shipments up from 1995.

text.p: Brazil's key port of Santos shipped 365,288 tonnes of sugar in September from its public terminals, up from 318,080 tonnes in the same month last year, according to a port authority spokesman.
In addition, 64,350 tonnes were exported from Cargill's private bulk sugar terminal. This however was down from the 82,300 tonnes shipped from the terminal in September 1995.
Of the 365,288 tonnes, bagged sugar accounted for 240,558 tonnes and bulk 124,730 tonnes.
This compares with 264,544 tonnes bagged and 53,536 tonnes bulk in the same period last year.
In January to September, some 1,591,735 tonnes were shipped from the port's public terminals against 1,587,804 tonnes in the first nine months of last year.

Of this, bagged sugar totalled 1,174,331 tonnes this year against 1,300,992 tonnes in 1995 while bulk sugar shipments were higher in the last nine months, reaching 417,404 tonnes against 286,812 tonnes in January to September 1995.
Shipments from Cargill's terminal totalled 376,746 tonnes against 231,000 tonnes in 1995, the port authority said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
